title: Canal Cruise with Unlimited Drinks & Bite Option
description: A canal cruise with a live guide and an optional unlimited-drinks package. Flagship Amsterdam uses an open boat in good weather and a covered saloon boat when it rains.
includes: Canal cruise with a local skipper and host
Unlimited beer, wine, soft drinks and snacks (if option chosen)
imageAlt: Amsterdam canal cruise with unlimited drinks and bites on an open boat with a local guide.
bestFor: First-time visitors who want a live guide
cancellation: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before

title: Amsterdam Evening (Sunset) Canal Cruise with Optional Drinks
description: A 1-hour evening cruise on an electric boat from in front of Amsterdam Centraal, with a local skipper (English and Dutch) and a free digital guide in 10 languages. Sunset views depend on the weather and season.
includes: Local skipper speaking English and Dutch
imageAlt: Amsterdam sunset canal cruise with friends enjoying drinks on an open boat.
cancellation: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before

title: Canal Booze Cruise with Unlimited Drinks Option (18+)
description: A 1-hour canal cruise for adults with a skipper, a host and an optional open bar. Guests must be 18 or over and bring ID. Snacks aren't included; stroopwafels are sold on board.
includes: 1-hour canal cruise with skipper and host
Digital audio guide in 10 languages (bring headphones)
imageAlt: Luxury Amsterdam canal cruise with friends enjoying drinks and bites on a sunny day.
bestFor: Adults (18+) who want drinks on board
cancellation: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before
